title: Replace V0 placeholder planet and sky with reusable cinematic rendering stack
research_summary: Keep the current stable R3F v8/WebGL2 stack. Reuse procedural-planets for the hero planet and its physically based atmosphere/ocean/volumetric clouds, Solar System Scope for a real Milky Way sky texture, Three.js/EffectComposer for the rendering pipeline, and the existing GSAP/camera-controls stack later for authored travel. Do not adopt @pmndrs/sky yet because its React bindings require R3F v10 alpha/WebGPU.

sources.finding: procedural-planets 0.5.1 is MIT, WebGL2, Three >=0.160, with terrain LOD, analytic ocean, volumetric clouds, physically based atmosphere, and PlanetPass/EffectComposer integration.
PlanetPass is designed to render directly after a RenderPass into an HDR composer so bloom and final tone mapping can see the planet.
Solar System Scope provides a Stars + Milky Way equirectangular texture pack under CC BY 4.0, based on NASA imagery/data.
Galaxy Explorer is MIT and demonstrates a production-oriented separation of painted galactic disc, procedural star points, cinematic travel and performance fallback.
@pmndrs/sky is MIT and high quality, but React bindings require R3F >=10 alpha and WebGPU, so it is not selected for the stable V1 mainline.

candidates.name: procedural-planets 0.5.1
candidates.reason: Directly compatible with our Three 0.187/WebGL2 stack and replaces the hand-built sphere shell with terrain, ocean, clouds and atmosphere.

candidates.name: Solar System Scope Stars + Milky Way texture
candidates.reason: Provides a real-looking deep-sky foundation immediately; attribution can be retained locally.

candidates.name: Galaxy Explorer
candidates.reason: Reuse its rendering/composition ideas and later port selected galaxy techniques; for this benchmark the priority is the hero planet, not a full galaxy transplant.

candidates.name: @pmndrs/sky 0.6
candidates.reason: Excellent visual candidate but its React path requires R3F 10 alpha/WebGPU. Upgrading the whole app would add unnecessary stability risk before the benchmark passes.

candidates.name: Continue polishing the existing sphere + transparent shell
candidates.reason: The V0 technique has already demonstrated a low visual ceiling and duplicates mature atmospheric/planet rendering work.

selected: Solar System Scope Milky Way texture
deferred: @pmndrs/sky until R3F v10/WebGPU is stable enough
full Galaxy Explorer port until the hero-frame benchmark passes
